title.en: The Rise of Design Engineering | Raphael Salaja | MIT Startup Week
title.zh: 设计工程的兴起 | Raphael Salaja | MIT Startup Week

summary.en: Raphael Salaja talks about the rise of design engineering, taste, craft, and the role of engineers who work close to product interaction and visual quality.
summary.zh: Raphael Salaja 分享设计工程的兴起，以及品味、工艺和工程师如何参与产品交互与视觉质量。
